title: Verify a synthesized reflex's output against its intent before registering
goal: VC-200-002's own residual: the probe run proves a model-written reflex executes, not that it is right. Register it only after intent-derived checks (given inputs -> expected outputs, plus VC-201-008 property checks when available) pass in the WASI sandbox; a failing reflex stays unregistered and the gap stays open. Tests vc_200_002_*.
